planets.name: TOI-663 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-663 with a 2.6-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-663 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-663. Its orbit and size follow Cointepas et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
